about.metaDescription: Longtail Travel plans private journeys in Thailand along its water and its seasons. Why we named the company after a boat, and how we work.
about.title: Named after a boat.
about.heroAlt: The bow of a longtail boat decorated with coloured ribbons and garlands
story: At six in the morning on Khlong Bang Luang, the water is the colour of jade tea. A longtail comes round the bend with its engine lifted, the propeller shaft held clear of the weeds, and the boatman steers by leaning on a pole as long as the boat. At the bow there are coloured ribbons and a marigold garland, still fresh, tied there for the spirit who keeps the boat safe.

We named the company after that boat because it goes where Thailand is actually lived: up the canals behind Wat Arun, across Cheow Lan Lake to a raft house in Khao Sok, between the limestone of Phang Nga Bay at the hour the tide lets you paddle into a hong.

Thailand has two coasts and they do not share a monsoon. We start every plan with the month. Then we choose the coast, the river and the north to match it. We book the Lanna house with a teak verandah, the cook who takes you to the market first, and the sanctuary where elephants are watched, not ridden. Then we leave the late afternoon open, when the light goes gold on the water.

how.title: You write to us
how.text: Tell us your dates, who is travelling and what you enjoy. There is no form you can get wrong.

how.title: We reply with a route
how.text: Within two working days, by email: a first route, the coast for your month and honest notes on the season.

how.title: We refine it together
how.text: Change anything. When it feels right, we send a written proposal with prices for your dates.

how.title: You travel
how.text: With every booking confirmed, documents in good time and a contact in Thailand while you're there.

principles.title: The month comes first
principles.text: We'll tell you when a place is wrong for your dates, and suggest where to go instead.

principles.title: Close to the surface
principles.text: Small boats, small places, local guides. Fewer stops, more time in each.

principles.title: Straight about ethics
principles.text: No elephant riding or bathing, no human zoos, and respect for the places we visit.

about.addressText: We work from Bangkok. Write to us first and we'll arrange a time to meet.
